device_name.notes: Project name; machine design is still evolving.

purpose.value: CNC plasma cutting with a water table; future manual tool changes may add drilling, scribing, and light machining.
purpose.notes: Keep plasma cutting as the first design priority.

narrative.value: Design a CNC plasma table for a community workshop. It should support at least 1000 x 2000 mm sheet stock within an outer envelope target of X 1600 x Y 2500 mm. The project includes a water table and adjustable table height. Future capabilities under consideration include drilling, scribing, light milling, and a tube-plasma rotary axis.
narrative.notes: Narrative summarizes current notes; it does not resolve open design decisions.

in_scope.value: Water table, slats, supporting structure, table lift, XY gantry and drives, torch Z/breakaway, control integration, and staged future tools.
in_scope.notes: Treat candidate/future components as proposals, not approved scope.

out_of_scope.value: Automated tool changer for the first build; production certification; detailed electrical safety design.
out_of_scope.notes: Manual tool change is the current project direction; confirm exclusions.

length_units.notes: Use mm for CAD geometry unless a field states otherwise.

coordinate_convention.value: Z up; define machine X/Y orientation before assembly modeling.
coordinate_convention.notes: Part-local datums should be explicit; do not infer global orientation.

operating_environment.value: Workshop; plasma cutting creates substantial EMI, heat, dross, and water exposure around the bed.

material_assumptions.value: Tank plate is documented as 6 mm steel; most other materials are undecided.
material_assumptions.notes: Do not infer steel grade or material properties.

safety_notes.value: Lift/counterweight, electrical isolation, plasma EMI, pinch points, and table stability need engineering review.
safety_notes.notes: CAD geometry and spreadsheet checks are not safety certification.

parts.name: Water tank and pan
parts.description: Welded water-table pan with base and four side walls.
parts.role: Supports workpiece and contains cutting water.
parts.spec_notes: Internal dimensions currently documented as 1712 x 1712 x 140 mm; verify assembly clearances and weld design.

parts.name: Replaceable slat grid
parts.description: Interlocking support fingers with toothed workpiece-contact edges.
parts.role: Supports sheet while allowing dross and water flow.
parts.spec_notes: 40 mm deep; 3 mm thickness is a preferred revision from the older 2 mm note; max spacing 50 mm. Slot direction and tooth dimensions need confirmation.

parts.name: Table support frame and legs
parts.description: Frame carrying tank, gantry loads, and lift reactions.
parts.role: Supports table and provides structural interfaces.
parts.spec_notes: Member sections, material, bracing, leveling feet, and loads are not specified.

parts.name: Table height lift
parts.description: Telescoping guides, cable/pulley assistance, counterweight, and positive locking pins.
parts.role: Raises/lowers table and holds selected height.
parts.spec_notes: Concept notes describe square-tube guides, cable/counterweight, and pin locking. Prior lift calculations assumed a shallower 100 mm water depth and need updating.

parts.name: XY gantry and motion system
parts.description: Long-axis rails/drive, cross-axis gantry, carriage, and motors.
parts.role: Moves the tool across the work envelope.
parts.spec_notes: HG20 guides and closed-loop NEMA 24 motors are under evaluation. Long axis rack preferred for speed; short-axis drive decision remains open.

parts.name: Torch Z and breakaway mount
parts.description: Vertical torch slide, clamp/interface, and collision breakaway.
parts.role: Positions and protects the plasma torch.
parts.spec_notes: Hypertherm torch has its own positioning sleeve/rack; clamp and Z arrangement need physical dimensions and confirmation.

parts.name: Powermax 65 machine torch
parts.spec_notes: Reference component only until exact torch variant and mounting dimensions are confirmed.

parts.name: Manual-change drill spindle head
parts.description: Optional drill/spindle tool head with separate motor and belt-driven spindle concept.
parts.role: Future drilling and light machining tool.
parts.spec_notes: 2.5 mm Z screw and Flipsky spindle motor are concepts in notes; do not combine the plasma Z and drilling Z until architecture is decided.

parts.name: CNC control and electrical system
parts.description: LinuxCNC/Mesa motion control, THC sensing, wiring, and cabinet.
parts.role: Controls motion, torch interface, and height sensing.
parts.spec_notes: Electrical layout and exact Mesa boards are not verified. Treat as a non-geometric assembly until detailed requirements exist.

parts.name: Tube rotary axis
parts.description: Optional fourth-axis fixture for tube plasma cutting.
parts.spec_notes: Customer wishlist only; tube range, chuck/support, drive, and removable mounting interface are undefined.

features.name: Tank base plate
features.description: Flat 6 mm plate forming the bottom of the water pan.
features.dimensions_or_intent: 1712 x 1712 mm internal dimensions; outside size and bend/weld allowance need definition.
features.notes: Geometry must distinguish inside dimensions from outside dimensions.

features.name: Tank side walls
features.description: Four walls enclosing the water pan.
features.dimensions_or_intent: 140 mm internal depth; wall joints and corner details unresolved.
features.notes: Do not infer weld prep or watertight construction details.

features.name: Drain outlet
features.description: Low-point outlet for draining water and dross.
features.dimensions_or_intent: At lowest floor-pan point; port size and valve interface TBD.
features.notes: Exact outlet orientation must be clarified before detailed CAD.

features.name: Shark-tooth contact edge
features.description: Narrow peaks provide discrete sheet contact.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Tooth pitch, height, tip width, and manufacturable profile TBD.
features.notes: README describes shark-tooth style; no dimensioned tooth profile.

features.name: Interlocking slots
features.description: Crossing slots allow the two slat directions to interlock.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Slot depth and fit clearance TBD; one slot set is from bottom, the crossing set from top.
features.notes: Slot pattern and slat count require definition.

features.name: Slat elevation
features.description: Sets the slat peaks below the tank rim.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Top contact peak 25 mm below tank rim.
features.notes: Height is from tooth peaks, not slat root.

features.name: Tank mounting interfaces
features.description: Interfaces carrying tank and lift loads.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Locations, bolt pattern, and support method TBD.
features.notes: Must coordinate with tank shell and lift.

features.name: Gantry rail interfaces
features.description: Reference surfaces for long-axis guide rails.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Rail spacing, straightness, and mounting arrangement TBD.
features.notes: HG20 is a candidate series, not a released rail layout.

features.name: Telescoping guide columns
features.description: Guide table motion while maintaining alignment.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Nested square tubes with bearing guidance; sizes and stroke TBD.
features.notes: Pinch points and buckling/stability require engineering review.

features.name: Cable and pulley assist
features.description: Counterweight-assisted manual lift concept.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Cable routing, pulley geometry, and rated hardware TBD.
features.notes: Existing lift calculations predate current 140 mm tank depth.

features.name: Height lock pins
features.description: Positive mechanical locks at discrete table heights.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Pin count, size, material, and hole positions TBD.
features.notes: Do not treat counterweight/cable as the sole support at rest.

features.name: HG20 guide rails
features.description: Linear guidance along machine axes.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Two rails and two blocks per axis are documented concept; lengths and spacing TBD.
features.notes: Long axis travel/speed and rail alignment require sizing.

features.name: Rack or ballscrew drives
features.description: Transmits motor torque to axis carriages.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Rack preferred for long axis; short axis drive not decided.
features.notes: Do not assume a final tooth count or screw lead.

features.name: Closed-loop stepper motors
features.description: Axis actuation with encoder feedback.
features.dimensions_or_intent: NEMA 24, 4 Nm motor under evaluation.
features.notes: Exact motor SKU/mounting pattern should be referenced.

features.name: Torch vertical slide
features.description: Provides torch height positioning and THC movement.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Stroke and guide arrangement TBD.
features.notes: Plasma Z architecture is not the drilling feed axis by assumption.

features.name: Breakaway interface
features.description: Detects or limits damage from torch collision.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Trip direction, repeatability, sensing, and reset method TBD.
features.notes: Physical mechanism is not dimensioned.

features.name: Torch clamp
features.description: Holds the machine torch sleeve in alignment.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Barrel and sleeve diameters must come from verified torch variant.
features.notes: Use authoritative torch drawing or measurement.

features.name: Positioning sleeve rack
features.description: Vendor rack interface associated with torch Z positioning.
features.dimensions_or_intent: 32 pitch/module approximately 0.8 mm per project notes; verify exact torch part.
features.notes: Reference spec is project research, not verified customer hardware.

features.name: Drill spindle
features.description: Optional spindle for small-hole drilling and light machining.
features.dimensions_or_intent: 6 mm maximum tool; target about 1300 rpm from sizing notes.
features.notes: Tool, bearing, and interface architecture unresolved.

features.name: Drill feed axis
features.description: Optional high-force Z feed for drilling.
features.dimensions_or_intent: 2.5 mm self-locking lead screw concept; design feed 2000 N.
features.notes: Do not merge with plasma torch Z without explicit architecture decision.

features.name: Torch height sensing
features.description: Arc voltage and ohmic sensing front-end.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Mesa THCAD-10 arc voltage and THCAD-5 touch-off are documented selection.
features.notes: High-voltage interface must follow manufacturer documentation; CAD model is schematic only.

features.name: Motion controller
features.description: LinuxCNC/Mesa control stack for coordinated motion.
features.dimensions_or_intent: LinuxCNC Qtplasmac and Mesa 7i76e documented direction.
features.notes: Verify exact board inventory and I/O mapping.

features.name: Tube support and rotation
features.description: Supports and rotates tube stock for fourth-axis cutting.
features.dimensions_or_intent: Stock diameter, length, chuck, tail support, and axis position TBD.
features.notes: Wishlist only.
